function tar_hdr($vardas, $dydis, $mtime) {
    $h = str_pad(substr($vardas,0,100), 100, "\0");
    $h .= str_pad('0000644', 8, "\0");
    $h .= str_pad('0000000', 8, "\0");
    $h .= str_pad('0000000', 8, "\0");

    $chk = str_pad(sprintf('%06o', $sum)."\0 ", 8, "\0");
    return substr($h,0,148) . $chk . substr($h,156);
}
function tar_add($tar, $vardas, $keliasFaile) {

}
function tar_add_str($tar, $vardas, $turinys) {

}

function b2($url, $hdr = array(), $post = null, $raw = false) {
    $ch = curl_init($url);
    $o = array(CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER=>1, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT=>300, CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT=>20,
               CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER=>$hdr, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER=>1);
    if ($post !== null) { $o[CURLOPT_POST]=1; $o[CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS] = $raw ? $post : json_encode($post); }
    curl_setopt_array($ch, $o);
    $b = curl_exec($ch); $code = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE); $e = curl_error($ch);
    curl_close($ch);
    return array('http'=>$code, 'json'=>json_decode((string)$b, true), 'err'=>$e ?: null);
}
